snippet.title: Homonculus - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Homonculus is a first-person Metroidvania boomer shooter that blends classic gothic inspirations with cartoony whimsy! Master intense combat, defeat intimidating bosses, and save the land of Gartvaria from its blight. Homonculus is coming soon to PC (Steam).
